shortDescription: Manage Layer 3 Outside (L3Out) BGP Peers (bgp:PeerP and bgp:InfraPeerP)

options.name: address_type_controls
options.description: Address Type Controls

options.name: admin_state
options.description: Admin state for the BGP session

options.name: allow_self_as_count
options.description: Number of allowed self AS. Only used if C(allow-self-as) is enabled under C(bgp_controls).

options.name: annotation
options.description: User-defined string for annotating an object. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_ANNOTATION) will be used instead. If the value is not specified in the task and environment variable C(ACI_ANNOTATION) then the default value will be used.

options.name: bgp_controls
options.description: BGP Controls

options.name: bgp_infra_peer
options.description: BGP Infra peer (bgp:InfraPeerP).

options.name: bgp_password
options.description: Password for the BGP Peer. Providing the password will always result in a change because the set password cannot be retrieved from APIC.

options.name: bgp_peer_prefix_policy
options.description: BGP Peer Prefix Policy. BGP Peer Prefix Policy is only allowed to be configured when I(bgp_infra_peer=true).

options.name: certificate_name
options.description: The X.509 certificate name attached to the APIC AAA user used for signature-based authentication. If a C(private_key) filename was provided, this defaults to the C(private_key) basename, without extension. If PEM-formatted content was provided for C(private_key), this defaults to the C(username) value. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_CERTIFICATE_NAME) will be used instead.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the BGP Peer.

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of APIC resolvable by Ansible control host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: interface_profile
options.description: Name of the interface profile.

options.name: l3out
options.description: Name of an existing L3Out.

options.name: local_as_number
options.description: The local Autonomous System Number (ASN) of the L3Out BGP Peer. The APIC defaults to 0 when unset during creation.

options.name: local_as_number_config
options.description: The local Autonomous System Number (ASN) configuration of the L3Out BGP Peer. The APIC defaults to C(none) when unset during creation.

options.name: node_id
options.description: Node to build the interface on for Port-channels and single ports. Hyphen separated pair of nodes (e.g. "201-202") for vPCs.

options.name: node_profile
options.description: Name of the node profile.

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this ACI module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: output_path
options.description: Path to a file that will be used to dump the ACI JSON configuration objects generated by the module. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_OUTPUT_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. This option is mutual exclusive with C(private_key). If C(private_key) is provided too, it will be used instead. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(ACI_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: path_ep
options.description: Path to interface Interface Port Group name for Port-channels and vPCs Port number for single ports (e.g. "eth1/12")

options.name: peer_controls
options.description: Peer Controls

options.name: peer_ip
options.description: IP address of the BGP peer.

options.name: peer_type
options.description: BGP Peer type.

options.name: pod_id
options.description: Pod to build the interface on.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for REST connection. The default value depends on parameter C(use_ssl). If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: private_asn_controls
options.description: Private AS Controls

options.name: private_key
options.description: Either a PEM-formatted private key file or the private key content used for signature-based authentication. This value also influences the default C(certificate_name) that is used. This option is mutual exclusive with C(password). If C(password) is provided too, it will be ignored. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_PRIVATE_KEY) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE) will be used instead.

options.name: remote_asn
options.description: Autonomous System Number of the BGP peer.

options.name: route_control_profiles
options.description: List of dictionaries objects, which is used to bind the BGP Peer Connectivity Profile to Route Control Profile.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing. Use C(query) for listing an object or multiple objects.

options.name: suppress_previous
options.description: If C(true), a GET to check previous will not be sent before a POST update to APIC. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_SUPPRESS_PREVIOUS) will be used instead. The default value is C(false). WARNING - This causes the previous return value to be empty. The previous state of the object will not be checked and the POST update will contain all properties.

options.name: suppress_verification
options.description: If C(true), a verifying GET will not be sent after a POST update to APIC. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_SUPPRESS_VERIFICATION) will be used instead. The default value is C(false). WARNING - This causes the current return value to be set to the proposed value. The current object including default values will be unverifiable in a single task.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of an existing tenant.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_TIMEOUT) will be used instead. The default value is 30.

options.name: transport_data_plane
options.description: Transport Data Plane type.

options.name: ttl
options.description: eBGP Multihop Time To Live

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_USE_PROXY) will be used instead. The default value is true.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(false), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_USE_SSL) will be used instead. The default value is true when the connection is local.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(ACI_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead. The default value is admin.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ACI_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead. The default value is true.

options.name: weight
options.description: Weight for BGP routes from this neighbor
